Giovanniello is a male NPC who appears at Ragunna's Pioneer Association building at night. He is an employee of Ragunna's Pioneer Association, tasked with filming the [[Carnevale]]. 

==Quests and Events==
''(To Be Added)
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Before the Carnevale) 
:'''Giovanniello:''' We can't afford to mess up at such a crucial moment... Is the film reel misaligned?
:{{DIcon}} What are you busy with?
:'''Giovanniello:''' Oh, as you can see, I'm adjusting the photography equipment. The entire studio is preparing for the long-awaited Carnevale after ten years. 
:'''Giovanniello:''' Many of these were transported through Lollo Logistics with the Montelli family's help. I heard cutting-edge photography equipment from the [[New Federation]] is on its way too.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like quite an event...
::'''Giovanniello:''' This is a first for me as well... In any case, the Pioneer Association will capture this milestone festival with the most perfect imagery.
:{{DIcon}} That must cost a lot, right?
::'''Giovanniello:''' Haha, well, money shouldn't be an issue for the Montellis...
::'''Giovanniello:''' In any case, the Pioneer Association will capture this milestone festival with the most perfect imagery. 
{{Dialogue End}}
